summary: Narrow winding road; wooded west edge has no pull-out, homes 13-19 m away.
reasons: No verge or room beside the lane
Steep and winding downhill beyond 200 m

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto dense bush, but dwellings sit 16-19 m away near 39 and 78 m and others closer further on.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; the west edge is a treed bank straight to the lane, so a van would stand in the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a centre line and regular passing traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this side; one car is parked on the opposite kerb near 100 m.

cannot_judge: Exact verge width under the canopy

best_section.where: West side of Jesmond Road just after the bend, under bush
